newsitem.title: JAPAN: Komatsu, India's L&T to form excavator venture.
newsitem.headline: Komatsu, India's L&T to form excavator venture.

text.p: Komatsu Ltd said on Monday it would set up a joint venture with India's Larsen and Toubro Ltd (L&T) to manufacture hydraulic excavators and components designed by Komatsu.

The new company, L&T-Komatsu Ltd will be capitalised at 1.2 billion rupees and will be equally owned by Komatsu Asia & Pacific Pte Ltd (KAP), a Komatsu unit in Singapore, and L&T, Komatsu said in a statement.
The joint venture will be formed in November and will have approximately 1,200 employees, it said.
Komatsu said the venture would be based in Bangalore, and that it expects a yearly output of 1,500 excavators by 2000.
The products will be marketed in India and neighbouring countries, Komatsu said.
Komatsu added the agreement would also allow L&T to market other Komatsu products distributed by KAP.
